objective: focal-taxon held-out regional recovery under identical Top-5 candidate budget

primary_same_pool_result.rule: mean difference >= 0.015 AND pair-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND sign-flip p < 0.05 on all 192 declared pairs
primary_same_pool_result.allowed_claim_if_passed: Practical Core exceeded the predeclared evidence-aware spatially balanced GRTS comparator with a 10-km minimum-distance constraint for this focal-taxon recovery objective

required_all: acsp_practical_core - official_grts_proportional_local: mean difference >= 0.015 AND pair-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND sign-flip p < 0.05 on all 192 declared pairs
acsp_practical_core - official_grts_equal: pair-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 on all 192 declared pairs
grts_family_superiority.allowed_claim_if_passed: Practical Core outperformed the predeclared official GRTS variants for this focal-taxon recovery objective
grts_family_superiority.if_failed: report method-specific results and do not generalize a win against one GRTS configuration to the GRTS family

required_all: separate native biosurvey end-to-end protocol passes its own predeclared gate
existing_tool_superiority.if_failed: do not claim general superiority over existing survey-planning tools

sdm_positioning.role: secondary decision-level comparator, not a superiority gate
sdm_positioning.interpretation: different decision target from continuous suitability; ACSP need not outperform fitted SDM to be differentiated
